high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of an arm with a tattoo. The tattoo is a simple, black line drawing that spans across the forearm. It features four distinct symbols, each representing a different season: On the far left, there is a flower with five petals, symbolizing spring. Next to the flower is a sun with rays extending outward, representing summer. Following the sun is a maple leaf, which is typically associated with autumn. On the far right is a snowflake, indicating winter. The tattoo is minimalistic and uses only black lines against the skin, creating a clean and elegant design.
